caption: The drawing depicts a wooden sideboard or cabinet with a rectangular structure, elevated on four legs. The cabinet is composed primarily of dark brown wood with lighter brown and black decorative elements. The top section features three front panels, with the central panel having an arched design flanked by two columns, and the side panels featuring geometric diamond patterns. Four thick, turned columns support the upper cabinet, each with carved, rounded segments. Below the upper cabinet, there are two drawers with round knobs, separated by vertical carved details. The legs supporting the piece are also turned and carved in a similar style to the upper columns. At the bottom, there is a flat, open shelf that spans the length and width of the sideboard. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color.
title: Court Cupboard
